preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is a single integer modulo 10^9+7 for each test case
postconditions.description: Each output must be the result of the function F applied to all possible distinct substrings of the input string, summed up and taken modulo 10^9+7.
